$comment: Declared composition/verifier/runtime expectations for the uvp suite. Schema-level accept/reject cases are EXECUTABLE via conformance/schema-assertions.json (valid fixtures and fixtures/invalid/*), run with --schemas <ajv 2020 module url>. Most expectations below are NOW EXECUTABLE in the uvp-composition suite (tools/uv-composition.mjs); only container-hashing and real-corpus admission stay declared.

vectors.note: base < official < map < mod; inside one rank the explicit order field decides; two same-rank dependencies without order is a typed refusal. The same field set by base and by a mod resolves to the mod value with provenance naming both writers
a dependency cycle across manifests is a typed refusal naming the cycle members, detected before any content loads
unsatisfied intrinsic or capability requirements refuse the composition BEFORE content bytes load
directory and archive packings of identical contents produce identical content hashes and one composition hash
